package.name: raon_operator_gui
package.description: Desktop operator station for the KV260 pick&place pipeline. Runs on the desktop, not the board. ONE Qt window (C++): the bbox-overlay video with resolution/FPS, an embedded RViz RobotModel driven by /joint_states via robot_state_publisher, and the robot app's terminal keys as buttons on /operator_key — each button enabled only when DoInput's own guards would accept the key (/robot_state). Run it INSTEAD OF detection_viewer_node — two subscribers double the board's JPEG egress.
